desired_result: New users complete the first task

return_cut.statement: I may favor redesign because it gives my analysis a larger role
return_cut.defeater: When a product-lead-owned comparison finds instruction sufficient, I recommend keeping instruction and closing this analysis

evidence.statement: In this fictional comparison, users still failed after clear instruction
evidence.source: Fictional comparison A; no real participants

defeat_test.method: Compare instruction with a simpler flow
defeat_test.observation: Instruction alone performs as well as the simpler flow

outcome.reason: Declared failures after instruction warrant a reversible trial. To limit the analyst's redesign preference, the product lead reviews the comparison and can choose to retain instruction instead.
outcome.stop_rule: Reconsider if instruction alone performs as well
